{{Quote|Don't say 'smuggler'. I prefer 'freelance pilot for hire'. Speaking of, are you hiring?|BoShek|<ref name="Outer Rim">[[Star Wars: Outer Rim|''Star Wars'': Outer Rim]]</ref>}}
'''BoShek''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Corellian]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from [[Corellia]] who worked as a [[Swoop racing|swoop racer]], [[smuggler]], and [[pilot]]-for-hire during the [[Imperial Era]]. He was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], and remained at large in later years, attending [[Zeva Bliss]]'s [[Kijimi summit|summit]] on [[Kijimi]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm BoShek. If you want to know my story, just keep your eye on the finish line.|BoShek|<ref name="SG" />}}
[[File:BoShek_Zephyr-K_SWSG.png|thumb|left|250px|BoShek winning the Malastare Classic, in a cutting from ''Racing Digest'']]
Hailing from [[Corellia]], BoShek<ref name="DB" /> was a [[Force-sensitive]]<ref name="FC">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' {{C|Card: BoShek}}</ref> [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="DB" /> who operated as a [[racer]] in his youth. He won first place in the [[Malastare Classic]], flying a double-barrelled [[Zephyr-K]] welded out of junkyard scraps, and his victory was covered in ''[[Racing Digest]]''. He also undertook a [[Swoop racing|swoop race]] through the [[Agrilat]] crystal [[forest]]s, flying a modified [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders|Mobquet]] [[swoop]] with an overtuned [[engine]] and illegal aftermarket [[booster]]s. He drifted into the lead swooper's slipstream, waiting to use his booster to overtake on a wide turn, but his competitor flashed his [[Baffle (component)|engine baffles]] and dumped [[coolant]] into the thrust exhaust, causing a fireball that BoShek flew into. He was forced to nose down into the oil slick below, nearly drowning and spending two weeks in a [[medcenter]] having slurry pumped out of his lungs. He racked up a debt he was unable to pay, and later raced the [[V-4X-D ski speeder|ski speeder]] circuit for a season in the [[Geister belt]], making enough to pay off his creditors.<ref name="SG">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era]], BoShek worked as a [[smuggler]] and [[pilot]]-for-hire.<ref name="DB" /> He was often hired to [[transport]] [[spice]] on the dangerous [[Kessel Run]].<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=BoShek - Cantina Patron}}</ref>

BoShek was friends with [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], and believed that [[Maz Kanata]] had romantic feelings for him. He found [[Smuggler's Guide|Maz Kanata's Journal]] in a chance parlor on [[Makem Te]], with a green [[sylop]] card on top bearing a message to Lando from [[Duchess]] [[Reina Sarapinia]]. BoShek intended on returning it to Maz when he next stopped at Takodana. He received word that his application into the [[Dragon Void Run|Dragon Void Rally]] was accepted, and intended to make the week-long journey to compete, hoping to break the streak of no Corellian winning in a [[standard century]]. While going through his lockers during the flight, he discovered a clipping from the old ''Racing Digest'' coverage of his [[Malastare]] Classic win, making him nostalgic. He hoped to win the Dragon Void to fund his next venture; threading [[The Corkscrew (Akkadese Maelstrom)|the Corkscrew]] through [[the Thunderhead]] during a [[Kessel Run]]. However, the race didn't work out as he hoped, and was won by another Corellian<ref name="SG" />—[[Han Solo]]<ref name="Han Solo 5">[[Han Solo 5|''Han Solo'' 5]]</ref>—which forced BoShek to return to hauling cargo, passengers, and animals to raise money. He considered heading to [[Tatooine]], but decided to visit Kanata on Takodana, and returned her logbook to her.<ref name="SG" />

[[File:BoShek-PotF.png|thumb|right|250px|BoShek was in Chalmun's Cantina the day Kenobi and Skywalker hired Han Solo.]]
Although he initially decided against visiting [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], believing it watered down its drinks,<ref name="SG" /> BoShek spent much of his downtime in [[Chalmun]]'s in [[Mos Eisley]], like many pilots.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=BoShek - Cantina Patron}}</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], he was present in the [[cantina]] the [[Standard day|day]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] were looking to hire a charter for [[Alderaan]]. Although BoShek did not take the job, he introduced Kenobi to [[Chewbacca]], the [[Wookiee]] associate of Han Solo.<ref name="ANH" />

Years later, BoShek attended the [[Kijimi summit|summit]] held by [[Zeva Bliss]], where his life was inadvertently saved by [[Poe Dameron]].<ref name="Free Fall">''[[Poe Dameron: Free Fall]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Bunch of stick jockeys and star-skaters in here, boasting when all they've really done is dig at the dirt and shoot at each other. A fueled-up engine and an open horizon, that's all anybody needs.|BoShek|<ref name="SG" />}}
BoShek was proud and boastful of his racing achievements, and looked down on "stick jockeys" and "star-skaters". He believed that a fueled-up engine and an open horizon was all anybody needed. He competed in high-speed swoop races despite the belief that humans were unable to compete at such speeds, putting the opinion down to a fear of the competition. He hoped to be the first Corellian in a century to win the Dragon Void Run, and grew nostalgic for his younger racing years while making the trip to compete. Though he lost the Dragon Void, BoShek sought new challenges and all-time records to beat.<ref name="SG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWC_BoShek.jpg|thumb|right|BoShek as he is depicted in ''Star Wars: Commander'']]
BoShek was portrayed in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] by [[Basil Tomlin]], an uncredited actor who remained unidentified for his role until [[2016]].<ref name="Finding BoShek">{{WebCite|url=https://billyjensen.com/finding-boshek|text=Finding BoShek|author=Jensen, Billy|date=2016-02-08|work=[https://billyjensen.com Billy Jensen]|archivedate=20201108161456}}</ref> According to [[Jerry Oltion]], who named him for his story in the [[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]] story collection, the name BoShek is a Tuckerization honoring twentieth-century SF writer Robert "Bob" Sheckley, who wrote many spacer tales in the 1950s. He is depicted talking to [[Saponza]] in artwork for the [[2014]] mobile [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''.<ref name="Commander">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref>
